upstream.codeText:
const TAU=Math.PI*2;
let sampleRate=8e3,
    mod=(n,m)=>(n%m+m)%m,fract=x=>(x%1+1)%1,
    mix=(a,b,x)=>a+(b-a)*x,
    clamp=(x,mn,mx)=>Math.min(Math.max(x,mn),mx),
    read=(a,i)=>a[mod(Math.floor(i),a.length)],
    readLinear=(a,i)=>mix(a[mod(Math.floor(i),a.length)],a[mod(Math.floor(i)+1,a.length)],fract(i)),
    sinc=x=>x===0?1:Math.sin(x)/x,
upstream.author: Funcbeat Anon
upstream.name: Freehand waveform + Freeverb
upstream.description: Originally set to 16kHz, raised to 48kHz to improve audio quality.
